dispositions.subject: Single-snapshot write-error classification
dispositions.reason: The implementation matches canonical upstream commit 01f387f4. The locked contract classifies an observed close 1009 as request-scoped and explicitly requires an immediate ordinary retry when the reader has not classified an error.

dispositions.subject: Handler data/error channel ordering
dispositions.reason: The branch preserves a pending structured error instead of replacing it with a synthetic timeout; no concrete non-1009 regression was verified.

dispositions.subject: Full executor race-suite failure
dispositions.reason: The reported race is in pre-existing Antigravity tests outside the Phase 1 allowlist; targeted Codex websocket race coverage passed during review.
